text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —An upside-down hospital room.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Upside down. Inside out. Light and shadow. Back to back.
Either one would have been fine.
Either one could have been real.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega?
text_block_list.text: —Then it could've been me, couldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega?
text_block_list.text:
To survive. To live on.
To run freely across the vast earth.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: I was good enough too, right, Sis?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Cloaked Figure
text_block_list.text:
It is TIME. The Kikuka-sho is about to BEGIN.
Let us head to the RACECOURSE.

text_block_list.name: Cloaked Figure
text_block_list.text:
LeT's HeAd To ThE rAcEcOuRsE.
Let'S hEaD tO tHe RaCeCoUrSe.
LEt's HEad To THe RacEcoUrSE.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: People wearing dark blue cloaks and orange masks fill the room. I'm being driven out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A long, long line stretches out.
Toward the stage of the Kikuka Sho. Toward Yodo's turf.
Carrying me along. Taking me there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Before long, I realize.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —That this was a funeral procession.

text_block_list.name: Commentator?
text_block_list.text:
The one claiming a spLendiD victory is 'XXXXXXX'!
'XXXXXXX'! CheErs of blessing are
eChoIng throughout Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Spectators?
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!!
"XXXXXXX"! "XXXXXXX"!
"XXXXXXX"! "XXXXXXX"!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: Ahaha—ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text:
That was fun, so much fun! I feel on top of the world!!
Ah—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: —Why?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: Why won't you properly make amends?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: Hey, if you're not going to use them properly, give them all back.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text:
Body. Legs. Heart. Soul.
Life itself.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: Every, every, every, every single thing... give it back to me.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: —If you're saying you can't do that...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, fall down to the same depths as me,
Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And then, a sharp pain shoots through my left leg.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...38th time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The same dream I see almost every night.
Ever since that night of the new moon...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...They won't be waking up anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(On the twelfth night,
I had an argument with Curren-san.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ("A dream is just a dream"? "She couldn't possibly be that kind of girl"? ...Well, maybe, but you never know.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because she is a child who has lost everything to understand with—words, body, life, everything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because I... stole everything away...!

...Ever since the summer camp ended,
Admire Vega has been acting strangely.

Perhaps unable to sleep well, her complexion has worsened,
and she is increasingly seen wearing a brooding, troubled expression.
And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm done getting ready.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If you don't have anything left to say, I'm heading over to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No problem.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "So, I will simply fulfill what must be done. No matter the stage... no matter the opponent."
Above all else, Admire Vega was—
...It looked as though that burning passion she showed at the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby, that spirit of enjoying the race, was completely gone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't look like there's anything else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well then.

Yet despite the desperate calls, it was in vain;
Admire Vega did not look back.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...—It's alright now.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I won't forget. I won't run away. Never again.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Never again... will I ever
run for my own sake――)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Ugh, the scent is almost suffocating.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The scent of darkness is just that thick.
...Even if stars shine all the more brilliantly
in the dead of night."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even so, there's no denying that what radiates from her is breathtakingly brilliant.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, is your war paint all set, Narita Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...If you mean ready to race,
then everything is in tip-top shape, Opera-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She never tells me anything,
so I know almost nothing about what happened to her
or what burdens she carries.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“Regardless of who she—of who Ayabe-san
was to her—”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Because I will not run away.
The Kikuka Sho is about to begin.
